issue_context.title: `pl.struct` not serializable
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Reproducible example

```python
import copy
copy.deepcopy(pl.struct("id"))
```


### Log output

```shell
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
RuntimeError                              Traceback (most recent call last)
Cell In[9], line 2
      1 import copy
----> 2 copy.deepcopy(pl.struct("id"))

File ~/.pyenv/versions/3.10.12/lib/python3.10/copy.py:161, in deepcopy(x, memo, _nil)
    159 reductor = getattr(x, "__reduce_ex__", None)
    160 if reductor is not None:
--> 161     rv = reductor(4)
    162 else:
    163     reductor = getattr(x, "__reduce__", None)

File ~/<redacted>/.venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/polars/expr/expr.py:235, in Expr.__getstate__(self)
    234 def __getstate__(self) -> Any:
--> 235     return self._pyexpr.__getstate__()

RuntimeError: BindingsError: "Value(\"serialize not supported for this 'opaque' function\")"
```


### Issue description

I am using patito to pass custom constraints to check multi columnar uniqueness. Currently the struct is not serializable so when I try to inherit another model it will throw the error.

### Expected behavior

Serialize the pl.struct properly.

review_comments: In the long run, do we plan to reduce the use of anonymous functions?
Yes, in fact existing anonymous functions should be rewritten to the common style and implementation dispatched to polars-ops.
Sounds good, I will find some time to help rewrite this. :)
